name: prompto
description: prompto in Claude Code: session context on every call, prechecks and tickets, an approval pane for human-approval rules, /prompto whoami|audit|kill

url.title: prompto URL
url.description: prompto's MCP endpoint (…/mcp); /v1/precheck and friends are next to it

token_file.title: Token file
token_file.description: File holding the agent role token, mode 0600. The plugin's own requests use it; Claude Code passes no plugin options to the MCP connection's headers helper, which reads ~/.config/prompto/token, so keep the token there

servers.title: MCP server names
servers.description: Comma-separated names of MCP servers that are this prompto (besides this plugin's own), e.g. a server added with `claude mcp add prompto …`

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: mod: the plugin sends prompto calls itself, with X-Prompto-Session. engine: Claude Code's own MCP connection (its permission prompt and settings hooks run; no session context)

scope_minutes.title: Approve for N minutes
scope_minutes.description: Length of an 'approve similar calls' approval (1-60)
